- Description: The textile fabric database consists of 245 images of 7 different fabrics. There are 140 defect-free images, 20 for each type of fabric. With different types of defects, there are 105 images. Images have a size of 4096×256 pixels. Defective images have been denominated as follows: nnnn_ddd_ff.png, where nnnn is the image number, ddd is the defect code, and ff is the fabric code. There is a mask of defect, denominated as: nnnn_ddd_ff_mask.png, where white pixels represent the defect area of the defective image. - Description: ### Context This dataset is intended for **fabric defect detection and classification** in industrial inspection scenarios. It is derived from the **TILDA (Textile Industrial Defect Dataset)**, a benchmark dataset for textile surface inspection developed by the Texture Analysis Group at the University of Freiburg [[1]](https://lmb.informatik.uni-freiburg.de/resources/datasets/tilda.en.html). All images are provided in **TIFF format**, with corresponding **YOLO-format bounding box annotations** and **binary segmentation masks**. ## Multi-Class Fabric Defect Detection Dataset
- Ref: `ziya07/multi-class-fabric-defect-detection-dataset`  
- Licence: **CC0-1.0**  
- Subtitle: Annotated images of textile defects for AI-based quality inspection systems  
- Total files listed: 3067, images: 3067  
- Description: This dataset is curated to support the development and evaluation of intelligent fabric defect detection systems in textile manufacturing environments. High-resolution CMOS-based smart cameras (Basler ace 2 Pro, 12 MP, USB 3.0) were mounted above the fabric flow at critical inspection points such as pre-finishing stages. These cameras were configured with adjustable focal lenses and LED backlighting paired with polarizing filters to ensure consistent illumination, reduce glare, and minimize shadow effects across fabric types. - Subtitle: A collection of fabric surface images for deep learning defect classification

- Description:  This dataset contains fabric surface images designed for training deep learning models to perform automated defect detection and classification. ### Structure The dataset is structured for multi-class/binary classification tasks: * **Classes:** Defect vs. Non-Defect (Defective / Good) * **Format:** PNG / JPG images * **Use Cases:** Quality control, automated visual inspection, CNN model training (ResNet, VGG, MobileNet, Inception). ### Citation & Usage If you use this dataset in your research or projects, please credit this page.

## stain_clothes(with level)
- Ref: `k23m23/stain-clothswith-level`  
- Licence: **CC0-1.0**  
- Subtitle: 6-Level Synthetic Fabric Stain Dataset with Segmented Garment Masks  
- Total files listed: 11874, images: 11872  
- Description: This dataset is designed for multi-class stain detection and severity classification in textile and laundry applications. It contains high-resolution images of garments with synthetically generated stains across six levels of intensity (Level 0–5), where Level 0 represents clean garments and Levels 1–5 indicate increasing stain severity. Unlike standard classification datasets, this dataset includes pixel-level segmentation masks for every image.
